question: Which company developed the Android OS, a mobile operating system Software in 2007? (RRB NTPC Tier I (29/04/2016) Shift 2)

question: In which year was the Mars Orbit Mission (MOM), Mangalyaan launched?A. 2012B. 2013C. 2014D. 2015 (RRB NTPC Tier I (29/03/2016) Shift 3)
options: D
A
C
B
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 2013

Explanation:
The Mars Orbiter Mission (MOM), also known as Mangalyaan, was launched by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) on 5 November 2013. It was India's first interplanetary mission and entered Mars orbit on 24 September 2014. This mission made India the first Asian country to successfully send a spacecraft to Mars and the fourth country in the world (after the USA, Russia, and the European Space Agency) to do so. Mangalyaan was launched using the PSLV-C25 rocket from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Andhra Pradesh. The mission aimed to study the Martian surface, atmosphere, and mineralogy.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Launch year of Mangalyaan → 2013
☛ Launch vehicle of Mangalyaan → PSLV-C25
☛ Mars orbit insertion date → 24 September 2014
☛ Launch site of Mangalyaan → Satish Dhawan Space Centre, Sriharikota
☛ Fourth country to send a Mars mission after Mangalyaan → India

question: Astrosat is India's firstA. Reconnaissance satelliteB. Remote sensing satelliteC. Space observatoryD. Communication satellite (RRB NTPC Tier I (30/03/2016) Shift 3)
options: C
B

solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Space observatory

Explanation:
Astrosat is India's first dedicated space observatory, launched on 28 September 2015 aboard PSLV-C30. It is a multi-wavelength astronomical mission capable of studying celestial objects in ultraviolet, visible, X-ray, and gamma-ray bands. Its payloads include UVIT, SXT, LAXPC, CZTI, and SSM. This was a landmark moment for Indian astronomy, making India self-reliant in studying the universe. The mission aims to observe objects like black holes, neutron stars, and supernovae.

question: Which of the following is a Space-Based Augmentation System?A. INSATB. GAGANC. GSATD. SARAL (RRB NTPC Tier I (30/03/2016) Shift 3)
options: C
B
D
A
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is GAGAN

Explanation:
GAGAN (GPS Aided GEO Augmented Navigation) is India's Space-Based Augmentation System. It is jointly developed by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) and the Airports Authority of India (AAI). This system is designed to enhance the accuracy and reliability of GPS signals, especially for aviation. GAGAN uses geostationary satellites and is a type of SBAS (Satellite-Based Augmentation System). It plays a vital role in air traffic management over India and its neighboring regions. Among the other options, INSAT and GSAT are communication satellites, while SARAL is an oceanography satellite.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:

☛ What type of system is GAGAN? → Space-Based Augmentation System
☛ Which organizations developed GAGAN? → ISRO and AAI
☛ In which field is GAGAN primarily used? → Aviation
☛ Which satellite system's signals does GAGAN augment? → GPS

गगन (GPS Aided GEO Augmented Navigation) भारत का स्पेस-आधारित ऑग्मेंटेशन सिस्टम है। इसे भारतीय अंतरिक्ष अनुसंधान संगठन (ISRO) और भारतीय विमानपत्तन प्राधिकरण (AAI) द्वारा संयुक्त रूप से विकसित किया गया है। यह प्रणाली GPS संकेतों की सटीकता और विश्वसनीयता को बढ़ाने के लिए डिज़ाइन की गई है, विशेषकर विमानन क्षेत्र में। गगन जियोस्टेशनरी उपग्रहों का उपयोग करता है और यह SBAS (Satellite-Based Augmentation System) का एक प्रकार है। यह भारत और आसपास के क्षेत्रों में वायु यातायात प्रबंधन के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है। अन्य विकल्पों में, INSAT और GSAT संचार उपग्रह हैं, जबकि SARAL एक समुद्री अध्ययन उपग्रह है।

question: Which of the following statements is true with respect to ASCII?A. A programming languageB. ASCII chart is not for decimalsC. American Security Code for Information InterchangeD. A character encoding scheme (RRB NTPC Tier I (30/03/2016) Shift 3)
options: D
B
A
C
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is D. A character encoding scheme

Explanation:
ASCII (American Standard Code for Information Interchange) is a character encoding standard used to represent text in computers as numeric codes. It defines codes for English letters, digits, and special characters using values from 0 to 127. ASCII is not a programming language; it is a data representation standard. Option A is incorrect because ASCII is not a programming language. Option B is incorrect because the ASCII chart does include decimal values. Option C is incorrect because the full form is American Standard Code for Information Interchange, not Security. Thus, option D is correct.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ What is the full form of ASCII? → American Standard Code for Information Interchange
☛ How many bits does ASCII use? → 7 bits
☛ How many characters are in ASCII? → 128
☛ What is the ASCII range? → 0 to 127
☛ Is ASCII only for English? → Yes, it encodes the English alphabet

solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है D. एक चरित्र एन्कोडिंग योजना

Explanation:
ASCII (American Standard Code for Information Interchange) एक कैरेक्टर एन्कोडिंग स्टैंडर्ड है जो कंप्यूटर में टेक्स्ट को संख्यात्मक रूप में दर्शाने के लिए उपयोग होता है। यह 0-127 तक के कोड में अंग्रेजी अक्षरों, अंकों और विशेष चिह्नों को परिभाषित करता है। ASCII कोई प्रोग्रामिंग भाषा नहीं है, बल्कि डेटा प्रतिनिधित्व का मानक है। विकल्प A गलत है क्योंकि ASCII प्रोग्रामिंग भाषा नहीं है। विकल्प B गलत है क्योंकि ASCII चार्ट दशमलव मानों को दर्शाता है। विकल्प C गलत है क्योंकि इसका पूर्ण रूप American Standard Code for Information Interchange है, Security नहीं। इस प्रकार, विकल्प D सही है।

question: Which of the following satellites launched by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) is a navigation satellite? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (21/01/2021) Shift 1)
options: SARAL
IRNSS-1I
SCATSAT-1
RESOURCESAT-2A
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is IRNSS-1I

Explanation:
IRNSS-1I is a navigation satellite that is part of India's indigenous satellite navigation system called NavIC (Indian Regional Navigation Satellite System). It was launched in April 2018 aboard PSLV-C41 to replace an older satellite. This satellite operates in a geosynchronous orbit at approximately 36,000 km altitude and provides accurate position, velocity, and timing services over India and the surrounding region. The other options: SARAL is an oceanography satellite, SCATSAT-1 is a weather satellite (scatterometer), and RESOURCESAT-2A is a remote sensing satellite for resource mapping. Thus, only IRNSS-1I belongs to the navigation category.
